scripts.build: pnpm hardhat clean && pnpm hardhat compile
scripts.deploy:all: pnpm deploy:verifiers:all && pnpm deploy:registry && pnpm deploy:registry:idcard && pnpm deploy:hub:v2
scripts.deploy:hub: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'pnpm hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/hub/deployHub.ts --network ${NETWORK:-localhost} ${VERIFY:+--verify}'
scripts.deploy:hub:v2: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'pnpm hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/hub/deployHubV2.ts --network ${NETWORK:-localhost} ${VERIFY:+--verify}'
scripts.deploy:pcr0: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'pnpm hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/utils/deployPCR0.ts --network ${NETWORK:-localhost} ${VERIFY:+--verify}'
scripts.deploy:registry: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'pnpm hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/registry/deployRegistry.ts --network ${NETWORK:-localhost} ${VERIFY:+--verify}'
scripts.deploy:registry:idcard: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'pnpm hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/registry/deployIdCardRegistry.ts --network ${NETWORK:-localhost} ${VERIFY:+--verify}'
scripts.deploy:test:selfverificationroot: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'pnpm hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/deployTestSelfVerificationRoot.ts --network ${NETWORK:-localhost} ${VERIFY:+--verify}'
scripts.deploy:verifier:idcard: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'pnpm hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/verifiers/deployIdCardVerifier.ts --network ${NETWORK:-localhost} ${VERIFY:+--verify}'
scripts.deploy:verifiers:all: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'pnpm hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/verifiers/deployAllVerifiers.ts --network ${NETWORK:-localhost} ${VERIFY:+--verify}'
scripts.set:hub:v2: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'NETWORK=${NETWORK} pnpm exec tsx scripts/setHubV2.ts'
scripts.set:registry: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'NETWORK=${NETWORK} pnpm exec tsx scripts/setRegistry.ts'
scripts.set:registry:hub:v2: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'pnpm hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/scripts/updateRegistryHubV2.ts --network ${NETWORK:-localhost} ${VERIFY:+--verify}'
scripts.set:registry:idcard: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'NETWORK=${NETWORK} pnpm exec tsx scripts/setRegistryId.ts'
scripts.set:verifiers:v2: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'NETWORK=${NETWORK} pnpm exec tsx scripts/setVerifiersV2.ts'
scripts.test:attribute: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'TEST_ENV=${TEST_ENV:-local} pnpm exec hardhat test test/unit/CircuitAttributeHandler.test.ts'
scripts.test:example: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'TEST_ENV=${TEST_ENV:-local} pnpm hardhat test test/example/*'
scripts.test:formatter: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'TEST_ENV=${TEST_ENV:-local} pnpm hardhat test test/unit/formatter.test.ts'
scripts.test:hub: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'TEST_ENV=${TEST_ENV:-local} pnpm hardhat test test/unit/IdentityVerificationHub.test.ts'
scripts.test:integration: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'TEST_ENV=${TEST_ENV:-local} pnpm hardhat test test/integration/*'
scripts.test:pcr: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'TEST_ENV=${TEST_ENV:-local} pnpm hardhat test test/unit/PCR0Manager.test.ts'
scripts.test:register: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'TEST_ENV=${TEST_ENV:-local} pnpm hardhat test test/integration/commitmentRegistration.test.ts'
scripts.test:registry: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'TEST_ENV=${TEST_ENV:-local} pnpm hardhat test test/unit/IdentityRegistry.test.ts'
scripts.test:sdkcore: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'TEST_ENV=${TEST_ENV:-local} pnpm hardhat test test/sdk/sdkCore.test.ts --network localhost'
scripts.test:unit: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'TEST_ENV=${TEST_ENV:-local} pnpm hardhat test test/unit/*'
scripts.test:v2: pnpm exec hardhat test test/v2/selfVerificationFlow.test.ts --network localhost
scripts.test:verifyall: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'TEST_ENV=${TEST_ENV:-local} pnpm hardhat test test/integration/verifyAll.test.ts'
scripts.update:cscaroot: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'pnpm hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/scripts/updateRegistryCscaRoot.ts --network ${NETWORK:-localhost} ${VERIFY:+--verify}'
scripts.update:hub: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'NETWORK=${NETWORK} pnpm exec tsx scripts/setRegistry.ts'
scripts.update:ofacroot: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'NETWORK=${NETWORK} pnpm exec tsx scripts/updateRegistryOfacRoot.ts'
scripts.update:pcr0: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'PCR0_ACTION=${PCR0_ACTION:-add} PCR0_KEY=${PCR0_KEY} pnpm hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/scripts/updatePCR0.ts --network ${NETWORK:-localhost} --reset'
scripts.upgrade: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'pnpm hardhat upgrade --network ${NETWORK:-localhost}'
scripts.upgrade:hub: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'pnpm hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/upgrade/deployNewHubAndUpgrade.ts --network ${NETWORK:-localhost} ${VERIFY:+--verify}'
scripts.upgrade:registry: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'pnpm hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/upgrade/deployNewRegistryAndUpgrade.ts --network ${NETWORK:-localhost} ${VERIFY:+--verify}'
scripts.upgrade:status: pnpm exec dotenv -- bash -c 'pnpm hardhat upgrade:status --network ${NETWORK:-localhost}'
